Your rights aren't being infringed upon just because everyone else disagrees with you and uses their downvoats to make your opinion hard to find.

Libertarianism supports the free market of ideas, and so if you can't stop people from mass downvoating your through persuasion, then you have failed in the marketplace. In the case of Reddit, they have essentially government enforcement to make sure that the truth is suppressed whereas on Voat or the Chans you find that the dominant opinion trends towards to actual truth.
